title: Embedding-density-driven mini-pack curation for quant calibration
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight, production-friendly procedure to curate calibration mini-packs for FP8/INT8 quantization that preserves rare but high-impact signal. The approach will use embedding-space density and distance metrics to stratify live prompt traffic and synthesize small representative bundles per domain. Goal: reduce calibration dataset size for on-device and dedicated inference while keeping accuracy degradation below defined thresholds in runtime-1.21 profiles.
context: Motivation: current calibration bundles are either too large (expensive, slow to run regressions) or randomly sampled (miss rare intents). Prior work on stratified and reservoir samplers retained bulk coverage but lacked sensitivity to embedding-space sparsity where quantization errors disproportionately hurt downstream quality. This ticket explores embedding-aware mini-packs that combine density-based stratification with exemplar oversampling and controlled synthetic perturbation for long-tail intents.
deliverables: Design doc (Confluence) with sampling algorithm and API contract
Prototype pipeline to generate per-domain mini-packs from live traffic and historical logs
Evaluation dashboard showing accuracy delta vs FP32 baseline across domains and latencies
Integration tests in calibration CI that accept/reject quant profiles based on mini-pack scores
acceptance_criteria: Per-domain mini-packs generated automatically from last 30 days of traffic
Mini-pack size configurable (default 1k examples) and reproducible
Quant profile evaluation using mini-packs shows <=0.8% average accuracy regression and no domain with >2.5% regression compared to FP32 baseline
End-to-end pipeline runs in <2 hours for a catalogue of 200 domains on CI hardware profile
Design doc reviewed and approved by ML infra and runtime teams
implementation_notes: Step 1: compute 512-d embedding for each prompt using the production embedder in batch jobs
Step 2: estimate local density via approximate kNN (faiss HNSW) and compute distance-to-centroid per domain cluster
Step 3: stratify examples into density quintiles and rarity buckets using reciprocal frequency of intent tags when available
Step 4: allocate mini-pack slots per-stratum with a tail boost multiplier for rare buckets (2x by default)
Step 5: perform light synthetic perturbations (query paraphrases + context truncation) for corner-case exemplars to increase coverage of model fragility points
Step 6: attach metadata (embedding centroid, density bucket, intent tag, generation timestamp) to facilitate debugging in Console
experiments_and_results: Prototype run on 50 domains, 1k mini-packs: mean accuracy regression 0.62%, 95th percentile regression 1.9%
Baseline random-sample mini-packs (1k) had mean regression 1.4% and 95th percentile 3.8%
Embedding-density sampler found 14% more rare-intent exemplars vs uniform reservoir (manual audit)
Latency to produce all mini-packs for 50 domains on CI: 18 minutes (embeddings compute dominant cost)
decisions: Use production embedder to avoid distribution shift between calibration and runtime
Prefer approximate kNN (HNSW) for scale; exact clustering is too slow for CI runs
Default mini-pack size set to 1k with ability to override per-domain via config
Synthetic perturbation limited to shallow paraphrasing to avoid label drift
risks: Embedding drift between offline embedder version and runtime embedder could reduce sampler effectiveness
Overfitting calibration packs to artifacts introduced by synthetic perturbations
Privacy concerns when using customer prompts for mini-packs in shared CI — must ensure anonymization and retention policies
Compute cost for embeddings at scale if run too frequently
mitigations: Pin embedder model version in pack metadata and add CI check for embedder-version compatibility
Limit synthetic perturbations and include human-in-the-loop review for initial rollout
Apply token-level hashing and k-anonymity thresholds; store only hashed identifiers for customer-sensitive prompts
Schedule nightly batch windows and cache embeddings to lower repeated compute
testing_plan: Unit tests for stratification logic and allocation heuristics
End-to-end CI job: generate mini-packs -> run quant evaluation -> compare against baseline thresholds
A/B evaluation in staging serving two quant profiles using curated mini-packs and a control random pack
Manual quality audit sampling 200 exemplars from tail buckets across 10 domains
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): run mini-pack generation nightly for top 50 domains and evaluate; collect metrics for 2 weeks
Phase 2 (limited prod): enable for Dedicated customers on experimental flag; monitor Console regressions and rollback if any domain exceeds thresholds
Phase 3 (GA): onboard all domains, expose per-domain pack size controls in Console, add scheduled re-generation policy
blockers: Final approval from Privacy team on use of live prompts for CI
Merge approval for PR #612 that exposes batched embedder endpoint
Access to additional CI GPU quota for wide-scale runs
notes: PM feedback (03-05): prefer conservative default to avoid surprising regressions for enterprise customers
Design review (03-08): runtime team requested explicit metadata to enable fast fallbacks based on pack-level failure signals
Follow-up: create monitoring alert for domain-level drift that triggers pack re-generation
